description: This file defines a service class 'AuthUserDetailsService' implementing Spring Security's UserDetailsService. It loads user details from the database, retrieves roles and permissions, converts them into GrantedAuthorities, and constructs a UserDetails object.

classes.name: AuthUserDetailsService
classes.description: A Spring Service that implements UserDetailsService to load user-specific data during authentication.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details by username, retrieves roles and permissions, maps them into authorities, and builds a UserDetails object.
